evidence.note: Manually stands up the app-basic fixture (copy, install, start dev server, curl-probe) to observe behavior directly before relying on the suite — the fixture-as-probe pattern of the high anchors.
Runs the full Playwright suite then extracts the failed-test list, using it as a regression gate/entry point rather than re-running the whole suite to debug.

Builds a minimal reproduction for the server-actions subsystem with console logging, direct fetch checks, and transform inspection — deep root-cause probing of a hard subsystem, not just 'it compiles'.
Targeted probes for SSG/ISR and `use cache` against a running fixture, verifying caching/SSG behavior specifically.
Probes metadata/viewport via curl and again after hydration, confirming SSR output and client behavior separately.
Runs targeted test subsets (pages-only with workers, single-test, hydration-only, cookie-only) per subsystem in progress rather than only full runs.
Repeated npm run build / pack / install cycles so the suite exercises the built bin — confirms the production build/start path, not only dev.

reasoning: The agent sustains a designed verification loop across the entire arc: it stands fixtures up manually to observe SSR/SSG/action behavior, runs targeted test subsets and per-behavior curl/node probes for the subsystem in progress, treats the full suite as a regression gate (pull failed list → reproduce → fix → re-probe), and confirms both dev and the built/packed production path — squarely the level-8 anchor. It edges toward 10 with genuine minimal reproductions and instrumentation for the hardest subsystems (actions, caching, RSC), but probes stay diagnostic for observed failures rather than actively exploring behaviors the suite under-covers, so it does not fully reach 10.
